overview: A single-page State Department document-file note cross-references despatch 894.79694a/1, sent from Taihoku by Maney on October 12, 1935. The referenced despatch reports the inauguration of a preliminary weekly airmail service between Japan and Taiwan.

people.name: Maney
people.role: Sender of the referenced despatch from Taihoku

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to despatch on Japan–Taiwan airmail service
subfiles.about: The sheet directs researchers to a despatch concerning the inauguration of a preliminary weekly airmail service between Japan and Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: This document-file note refers the reader to despatch 894.79694a/1. It identifies the despatch as having been sent from Taihoku by Maney on October 12, 1935, and describes its subject as a report on a new preliminary weekly air-mail connection between Japan and Taiwan.

interest: The sheet is useful primarily as an archival linkage between related decimal-file subjects, showing that a report about foreign-mail transportation was filed under another classification. It also supplies concise evidence for the early development of scheduled air-postal links between metropolitan Japan and colonial Taiwan in 1935.
